Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Half are Kinder Bueno… half are Nutella… but which one would you grab first? 🤤  Ingredients * 500 g all-purpose flour * 7 g instant yeast * 60 g sugar * 1 tsp vanilla extract * 1 tsp salt * 2 eggs * 220 ml warm milk * 70 g softened butter Filling * Kinder Bueno spread * Nutella For coating * Melted butter * Granulated sugar Instructions 1. Combine the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. 2. Add the eggs, warm milk, and butter. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth and elastic. 3. Cover and let the dough rise for 1½–2 hours, or until doubled in size. 4. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a smooth ball. 5. Place on parchment paper, cover, and let rise again for 30–45 minutes. 6. Heat oil to 170°C (340°F) and fry for about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown. 7. Drain on paper towels, brush lightly with melted butter, and coat in sugar while still warm. 8. Once slightly cooled, use a piping nozzle to make a hole in each Bombolini and fill 4 with Kinder Bueno spread and 4 with Nutella. 9. Serve immediately and enjoy the gooey center! #nutella #bomboloni #donuts #Recipe #baking

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Makes 4 servings 🥩 Steak • 1½ lbs sirloin steak, cut into bite-size pieces • 1 tbsp olive or avocado oil • 1 tsp chili powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp cumin • Salt & pepper to taste • Juice of ½ lime -If you are feeling extra froggy you can make a glaze after you take the steak out of the pan with some honey and broth and then let your steak dance in that sauce to get nice and glossy 🥔 Crispy Potatoes • 800g russet or Yukon gold potatoes, diced • 1 tbsp olive or avocado oil • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp paprika • Salt & pepper to taste 🌽 Creamy Street Corn • 2 cups corn • ⅓ cup nonfat Greek yogurt • 1 tbsp light mayo • ¼ cup cotija cheese • Juice of 1 lime • 1 tsp chili powder • Salt to taste • Chopped cilantro, optional 🧀 High-Protein Queso • 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese • ½ cup reduced-fat shredded cheddar • ¼ cup Fairlife 2% milk • 2 tbsp diced green chiles • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp chili powder • Salt to taste • 1 tbsp nutritional yeast 🔥 MACROS PER BOWL (1/4 recipe) 705 Calories | 60g Protein | 56g Carbs | 28g Fat #highprotein #lowcalorie #recipe #easytomake

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

POV: your dinner is watching you👁️👁️👻😂🤭 Save this recipe for Halloween🎃 Spooky Eyeball Stuffed Shells Ingredients: For the filling: • Vegan ground beef - 12 oz (340 g) • 1 Bell pepper, finely diced • 1 Onion, finely diced • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Tomato paste - 1 tbsp • Tomato sauce - 1/3 cup (80 ml) • Smoked paprika - to taste • Italian seasoning - to taste • Olive oil - 1 tbsp • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the tomato sauce: • Strained tomatoes - 26.5 oz (750 g) • Agave syrup - 1 tsp • Italian seasoning - 1 tsp • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the stuffed shells: • 18 Jumbo pasta shells • 9 Mini vegan mozzarella balls, halved • Black olives - as needed, sliced • Tomato paste - as needed, for the veins • Fresh thyme - optional How to make: 1. Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. Stir 1/3 cup (80 ml) of the tomato sauce into the filling. 5. Cook the jumbo shells according to package directions until al dente. Drain and let cool just enough to handle. 6. Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Stuff each shell generously with the filling and arrange in the dish. 7. Spoon a little tomato sauce over each shell. 8. Top each shell with half of a mini vegan mozzarella ball and a slice of black olive to create the pupil. Use a small amount of tomato paste to draw thin red veins over the mozzarella, then add a little fresh thyme if desired. 9. Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 15 minutes. Makes about 18 stuffed shells. #halloweenstuffedshells #eyeballstuffedshells #spookypasta #halloweenpasta #stuffedshells

Pumpkin Cinnamon Pull-Apart Bread 🤎 Happy first day of fall! 🍂🎃 Tis the season for all things pumpkin, and this is one of my all-time favourites✨ And for ALL of you asking: the Osta app link is in my bio, or you can search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play! Recipe: 1 can biscuits 1 cup sugar 1 tbsp cinnamon 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice ½ cup pumpkin puree 1 stick butter, melted Instructions - Open the biscuits and split each one in half, so you have 16 biscuit portions. Mix the sugar, cinnamon, and pumpkin pie spice together in a shallow bowl. Melt the butter in a separate bowl. - In another bowl, mix the pumpkin puree with 1–2 tbsp of the cinnamon sugar mixture. - Dip each piece of biscuit in the melted butter, then coat completely in the cinnamon sugar. - Stack the biscuits on top of each other, adding about ½–1 tsp of the pumpkin mixture between each biscuit. Place the stack sideways into a loaf pan. - Bake at 350°F for 35–40 minutes, or until baked through and golden. Save this for your next fall baking day! 🎃🍂 @Osta - Recipe Tracker

Garlic Butter Beef Linguine with Creamy Parmesan Cheddar Sauce 🥩🧄🧀🍝 This Garlic Butter Beef Linguine is creamy, cheesy, and packed with rich garlic butter flavor. Tender seasoned ground beef is tossed with linguine in a silky Parmesan cheddar sauce for an easy, comforting dinner everyone will love. Ingredients * 12 oz linguine * 1 lb lean ground beef * 1 tbsp olive oil * 3 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * 1/2 cup beef broth * 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese * 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * Salt and black pepper, to taste * 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Instructions 1. Cook the linguine according to the package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess grease if needed. 3. Add the butter and minced garlic. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the beef broth and heavy cream. Stir well and simmer for 3–4 minutes. 5. Add the cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese, stirring until completely melted and smooth. 6. Season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. 7. Add the cooked linguine to the skillet and toss until every strand is coated in the creamy sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. 8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately. Serving Suggestions Serve with garlic bread, Caesar salad, roasted broccoli, or sautéed green beans. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently with a splash of milk or cream. Time * Prep Time: 10 minutes * Cook Time: 20 minutes * Total Time: 30 minutes Servings: 4–6 Save this recipe and follow for more easy comfort food recipes! ❤️ #GarlicButterBeef #CreamyPasta #Linguine #GroundBeefRecipes #EasyDinner

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

How to Make Sticky Toffee Pudding 🇬🇧🍨  FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  (feeds 6 people) INGREDIENTS: Pudding ⬇️ 225g pitted dates (~250g unpitted) 1 + 3/4 cups AP flour 1/2 cup boiling water  2 teabags earl grey  1/2 cup milk, at room temperature  2/3 cup + 1 tbsp unsalted butter, softened 2/3 cup brown sugar 2 eggs, at room temperature  2 tbsp molasses 2 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp baking soda 1.5 tsp baking powder 1 tsp fine salt Toffee Sauce ⬇️ 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup unsalted butter 2 tsp molasses  To Finish ⬇️ Flaky salt (to taste) 1 pint vanilla ice cream INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Pre-heat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.  2. Bring your water to a boil. If you’d like to try some date-earl gray tea as well, add an extra cup of boiling water (it was actually quite delicious!) 3. Remove the pits from your dates if you haven’t already. Roughly chop your dates, and add them to a heat-proof container. Pour the boiling water over your dates, and add your tea bags. Let the tea steep for 5 minutes, then remove your tea bags. Remove your tea to drink if you added some extra, leaving only a 1/2 cup of hot water to submerge the dates. Add your 1 tbsp of baking soda, and mix it in with the dates (the mixture should start to foam). Let sit for another 5 minutes. 4. While still warm, blend your date mixture with an immersion blender, and set aside to cool to room temperature. In a large mixing bowl, add 2/3 cup of softened butter. Mix with a hand mixer until the butter is smooth & spread around the bottom of the bowl. Add your brown sugar, and mix once more until the butter & sugar are homogeneous, and have increased in volume (~2 minutes). Each time you mix in a new ingredient, be sure to scrape down the sides of the bowl. One at a time, add your eggs and mix them in on low speed (don’t mix too aggressively!) Wait until the first egg is well incorporated before adding the second one. Add your milk, molasses, and vanilla extract to the bowl, and mix once more to combine.  5. Next, grab a spatula and fold in your date purée. Quickly whisk your baking powder & salt into your flour in a separate bowl. Once incorporated, start adding your flour, about 1/2 cup at a time, using a strainer to sift the flour into the bowl (this will remove any clumps). Ensure each 1/2 cup of flour is well incorporated before adding the next.  6. Grease 6 4.5oz ramekins with your remaining tbsp of softened butter, ensuring they are very well coated. You do not want your STPs to stick to the ramekins! Evenly divide the batter between the ramekins, ensuring you leave at least 1cm of space below the rim (because the puddings will rise quite a bit when baking). 7. Bake the ramekins for 20-30 minutes, or until a cake tester/toothpick comes out *slightly* moist when inserted in the middle of the pudding (not gooey with batter, but not dry either).  8. While the puddings are baking, make your sauce. Add your butter, cream, brown sugar and molasses to a pot, and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once at a boil, turn the heat down to low, and cook down your sauce until it has thickened & darkened in colour. You will know it’s done when the bubbles on the surface of the sauce are very small (because most of the moisture has already boiled away). Remove your sauce from the burner, but keep in a warm place.  RECIPE CONTINUES IN THE COMMENTS ⬇️ #stp #stickytoffeepudding #dessert #homecooking #recipe

This one pot meal is no fuss and comes together in less than 30 minutes. I used left over roasted chicken thighs and this was a great way to use those leftovers! Recipe 👇 One Pot Cheesy Chicken Macaroni Ingredients * 1 box (16 oz) macaroni pasta * 4 cups chicken stock (more if needed) * 1 tsp garlic salt * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp dried oregano * ½ tsp salt * Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste * Precooked chicken, shredded or chopped (I used leftover roasted chicken thighs) * ¼ cup heavy cream * 1 cup shredded mozzarella, divided * 1 cup shredded Monterrey jack or cheese of your choice  Directions 1. In a large, oven-safe pot, combine the macaroni, chicken stock, garlic salt, paprika, onion powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is just under al dente, about 7–10 minutes. Add more stock or water as needed. 2.Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in the heavy cream and the precooked chicken. Cook until heated through and the pasta is tender. 3. Stir in ½ cup mozzarella, and ½ cup Monterey Jack until melted and creamy. Add a little more stock if it’s too thick for your liking. 4.Sprinkle the remaining cheeses  evenly over the top. Place under the broiler for 2–3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, and lightly golden. 5. Serve: Remove from the oven and serve immediately #easyrecipe #onepotmeals #familymeals #macncheese #chickenrecipe

videos.caption: I’m excited to announce you can now find my (current) favorite dough recipe along with all my others on my @recime.app page linked in my bio! ReciMe makes it easy to save and organize all your favorite recipes in one place so you can actually find them when you need them. Download it for free and give it a try with my recipe below: Ingredients for 3 16 inch pizzas: -Bread Flour - 545g -All Purpose Flour - 295g -Instant Yeast - 0.5g -Salt - 21g -Sugar - 16g -Olive Oil - 16g -Water- 545g Directions: 1. Add the dry ingredients together with the smallest amount of yeast and give it a quick mix 2. Add water at 55°C and olive oil to the dry mixture and mix with a rubber spatula or hand until mostly incorporated, allowing the dough to be sticky 3. Continue mixing for four to five minutes until the dough stops sticking to your hands, ensuring the dough temperature is around 72°C 4. Cover the dough in an oiled container and let it rest for 30 minutes 5. Wet your hands and perform four stretch and folds on the dough 6. Cover the dough for another 30 minutes and check the window pane test; if it tears easily, repeat the stretch‑and‑folds and rest cycles every 30 minutes until it passes the test 7. Let the dough sit on the counter overnight for about 12 hours until it has doubled or tripled in size 8. Store the dough in the refrigerator for one to two days to develop gluten and flavor 9. About five hours before you plan to make pizza, remove the dough from the fridge, shape it, and bake as desired #ReciMePartner #pizza #dough #recipe

High Protein Grilled Cheese Loaded Breakfast Burritos🌯 62g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Burrito - 10 Total) 576 Calories 18gC | 24.5gF | 62gP Ingredients:  1 Brown Onion (diced) 1.5KG Extra Lean Beef Mince 1 Tsp Salt, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Sage, 1 Tsp Thyme, 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika 4 Garlic Cloves (diced) 100ml Worcestershire Sauce 350g Tomato Paste 14 Eggs, 200g Egg Whites & 1 Tsp Salt 25g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 10 Warm Tortillas (Simsons Pantry Large Low Carb Tortillas) 25g Sriracha Mayonnaise (per burrito) Chives 25g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (per burrito - Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese) Instructions. 1. Cook the diced onion in a large pan over medium heat until softened. 2. Add the beef mince, break it up with a spoon and season with the spices. Cook until browned. 3. Stir through the garlic and Worcestershire sauce, then cook until the beef is fully cooked. 4. Add the tomato paste, mix well and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, egg whites and salt until combined. 6. Melt the butter in a separate pan over low to medium heat. Add the egg mixture and gently stir and fold until fluffy. Set aside. 7. Add a portion of the beef and scrambled eggs to each warm tortilla. Drizzle with Sriracha mayo (optional) sprinkle with chives and roll tightly. 8. Sprinkle grated cheddar cheese into a clean pan over low heat and immediately place a burrito seam-side down on top. 9. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes until the cheese is golden and crispy fully sealing the burrito. Repeat with the remaining burritos. 10. Wrap each burrito individually in foil and store in the fridge or freezer. Reheating Instructions: From frozen: Remove the foil and microwave for around 2 minutes to thaw, then air fry or oven bake at 190°C for 5 to 8 minutes until heated through and crispy. Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies 🎃🍪 (recipe makes 10-12 large cookies) Ingredients: ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter (brown it) ⅓ cup (80g) canned pumpkin purée, blotted *spread on a plate and blot with a paper towel 3-4 times. it should be 70g after blotting.  ⅔ cup (134g) brown sugar, packed ¼ cup (50g) granulated sugar 1 egg yolk, room temp 2 tsp vanilla extract 1½ cups (180g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ½ tsp baking soda ½ tsp salt 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice ¾ cup chocolate chips (+ some more for topping!) Ingredients: In a saucepan, brown the butter over medium heat. Stir constantly until it foams then turns a golden brown color. It should have a nutty aroma with little brown bits. Transfer to a heat safe bowl (make sure to get all those little brown bits in there!) Cool for about 10 minutes. Mix the slightly cooled brown butter, blotted pumpkin, and both sugars together.  Mix in the egg yolk, and vanilla until smooth. *blotting the pumpkin removes some of its moisture & helps prevent the cookies from becoming cakey. don’t skip it!  In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, pumpkin spice, and salt.  Gently fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips. Do not over mix. Chill the dough for 30-60 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 350°F.  Scoop ~2 tbsp of dough per cookie placing them on a parchment lined baking sheet with ample space between each other. Top each with additional chocolate chips.  Bake for about 10-13 minutes until the edges are set & lightly golden. Cool for about 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack. Enjoy! #bakingrecipe #chocolatechipcookies #pumpkincookies #pumpkin #fallrecipes
